summary.intent: Set up a Jenkins-based CI system for the Gkeyll repo (mirroring an old SUNDIALS Jenkins setup) to automatically run unit and regression tests on PRs targeting main, initially on the user's laptop with a workstation to be added later.
summary.outcome: Created ci/jenkins/Jenkinsfile (scripted pipeline running `make check` and `make regression` in parallel across named nodes) and ci/jenkins/README.md (full Homebrew Jenkins install/setup walkthrough), iterated on node naming (mana-node → manauref_lt1), fixed an incorrect JENKINS_HOME path in the README, and advised on GitHub PAT scoping. Manual GUI setup (install, credentials, job creation) remains for the user to complete.

repo: Repo is github.com/gkeyllorg/gkeyll (public), not the initially assumed ammarhakim/gkylzero
No automated regression-test runner exists yet in the Makefile — `make regression` is build-only today, actual regression execution is manual
CI files live under ci/jenkins/ (not test/jenkins/, per user preference) mirroring SUNDIALS' test/jenkins layout
workflow: Homebrew's Jenkins (jenkins-lts) uses JENKINS_HOME at ~/.jenkins by default, not /opt/homebrew/var/lib/jenkins as commonly assumed/documented elsewhere
Declarative `pipeline {}` blocks can't mix with scripted `node()`/`parallel` blocks — multi-node parallel execution requires a fully scripted pipeline
Since a personal laptop/workstation behind NAT can't receive inbound GitHub webhooks, SCM polling (e.g. every 2 minutes) is the practical trigger mechanism instead of webhooks

For a public repo, a fine-grained GitHub PAT scoped to just that repo (Contents: read, Metadata: read, Pull requests: read, Commit statuses: read/write) is sufficient and safer than a classic token's account-wide `public_repo` scope

friction: User initially gave wrong repo URL (ammarhakim/gkylzero) before correcting twice to gkeyllorg/gkeyll
README's documented initialAdminPassword path was wrong (assumed /opt/homebrew/var/lib/jenkins instead of actual ~/.jenkins), causing a file-not-found error for the user
First Jenkinsfile draft was invalid syntax (mixed declarative and scripted pipeline styles), had to be rewritten
Node label needed renaming twice (mana-node → manauref_lt1) after initial plan was already implemented
open_items: User still needs to complete manual GUI steps: Jenkins install finalization, GitHub PAT creation, multibranch pipeline job setup
Workstation ('workstation-node' or similar) onboarding deferred to later per original ask
No automated regression test runner exists yet — `make regression` only builds; actual test execution/reporting logic still needs to be written
If 'mana-node' label was already applied to the built-in node in Jenkins UI, user needs to manually update it to 'manauref_lt1' to match the renamed Jenkinsfile/README
